name: Hass Avocado

sections.bodyString:
• Bag of 4 Hass Avocados
• Fresh avocados are exactly what you need in healthy snacks, power bowls, avocado dressing, salads and avocado salsa
• Like all avocados, hass avocados are the lowest sugar fruit and provide unsaturated “good fats” that help absorb Vitamin A, Vitamin D, Vitamin K and Vitamin E
• A cholesterol free fruit that contains nearly 20 vitamins, minerals and phytonutrients including Vitamin E, Vitamin K, Vitamin C and Vitamins B5 and B9
• Ripe avocados should yield to gentle pressure without leaving indentations or feeling mushy

Avocados aren’t just great-tasting fresh produce items, but they are a nutrient-dense food enjoyed around the world. Hass avocados are a versatile ingredient that can be used in many different types of recipes and dishes because of their creamy texture and mild flavor. Enjoy these hass avocados on their own or in Mexican food like tacos or burritos, as part of healthy snacks, in a fresh salad, fresh guacamole, avocado spread or on avocado toast. Not only is a hass avocado a great ingredient to use in numerous recipes, but it is also a healthy food that contributes unsaturated “good” fats and nearly 20 vitamins, minerals and phytonutrients including Vitamin E, Vitamin K, Vitamin C and Vitamins B5 and B9. A ripe avocado will have dark green to nearly black skin color and a bumpy skin texture; however, color isn’t always the best indicator of ripeness. Ripe avocados should yield to gentle pressure without leaving indentations or feeling mushy. Avocados with a slightly bumpy texture should be ripe in 1 to 2 days. They will also be somewhat firm and have a dark green and black speckled color. Order a bag of avocados and you’ll see that the possibilities are deliciously endless.

sections.bodyString: Virtues: Sustainable. Our fresh sushi grade salmon is responsibly sourced from certified sustainable producers who do not use growth hormones. Pure: Thin non GMO salmon is a hard cured pure sea salt + soft brown sugar. Our process involves no artificial preservatives colors or flavors. Local: The salmon is smoked over a bed of locally sourced Florida orange + grapefruit wood to create a light fruity smoke flavor. It is allowed to rest after smoked to enable the sea salt & citrus wood notes to permeate throughout the fillet. We classify our salmon in three smoke profiles, so finding your favorite is easy. Mild. Medium. Bold. Salmon is a good source of omega 3 fatty acids, helps lower cholesterol and improves overall heart health. Facebook. Twitter. Instagram. Visit us at saint.miami. FSC. www.fsc.org. READY IN 10-15 MINUTES: Created in conjunction with award winning chefs, this ready to cook restaurant quality pasta dinner can be prepared and served quickly and easily.

CACIO E PEPE FLAVOR: Lazy Food Chefs deliver an authentic cheesy culinary experience using romano cheese. Experience the rich creamy sauce offering a burst of flavor to elevate your cheesy dinner nights.

1 PACK / 2 SERVINGS: Includes 1 individual pouches of meals; Each pouch meal packs 2 servings. Meals for healthy people with less time to cook.Optimal fiber for digestive wellness.

sections.bodyString:
Sometimes the simplest foods are the most enjoyable. It doesn’t get much less complex than Fiorucci Paninos. Made from the leg of the Serrano pig, our Jamón Serrano has been dry cured for at least 12 months. It has less fat than prosciutto and a much firmer texture. This provides an outstanding accompaniment for the tangy, fruity, and nutty Manchego that is inside. While they are absolutely delicious enough to enjoy on their own, our panino is ideal to serve as the centerpiece of a meat and cheese snack tray at your next party. They are easy-to-serve and are a great way to start the meal or share with friends as an easy tapas. These protein-packed snacks are ideal for everyone from kids to enjoy after school or you to have with your favorite wine. You can even add it to a selection of fresh fruits and vegetables for a delicious last-minute appetizer. Just because you might not be able to make it to Italy right now, doesn’t mean you shouldn’t eat like an Italian. 
Fiorucci has been delivering the true taste of Italy through specialty meats for over 170 years. We use authentic, old-world recipes, hand-trimmed cuts of pork, and the finest ingredients to give you an extensive line of slowly aged Italian meats. The result? Perfection.

sections.bodyString: Blount Clam Shack New England Clam Chowder is a delicious, locally made in New England cream-based soup that is ready to heat and eat for all seafood lovers. This authentic New England Clam Chowder soup is carefully kettle cooked with sweet cream and flavorful clam broth that’s loaded with chunks of clams, potatoes and spices. Locally made and award winning, Blount New England Clam Chowder is gluten free and doesn’t rely on a complicated recipe or complicated ingredients. Blount Clam Shack New England Clam Chowder is perfect for any time you are in the mood for a conveniently delicious clam chowder soup. Perfect as a lunch meal or an easy dinner bowl, heat this meal in the microwave on high for 5 to 6 minutes, stir halfway through and let stand for one minute for a delicious snack. Store this cup of thick soup in the refrigerator until you are ready to taste restaurant-quality seafood soup. Bringing food, family and friends together for five generations.

This gluten free soup makes it easy to be intentional about the way you stock your pantry. Enjoy it on its own as a quick and easy vegan snack, customize it with your favorite toppings, or pair it with a salad, sandwich, or wrap. You can also use it to create flavorful sauces or as a base for your favorite side dish. Each 32 oz resealable carton contains about 4 servings of deliciously simple butternut squash soup. To prepare, simply pour, heat until hot, stir, and enjoy. In addition to Butternut Squash, Pacific Foods offers Cashew Carrot Ginger, Creamy Tomato, and more. sections.bodyString: All-Natural American classic. Small batches ancient techniques. Fresh milled flour nutritious & flavorful. Long fermentation easy to digest. Plant based. Est. 1994. Our high country interpretation of the classic SF Style Sourdough. Three days of fermentation create the tangy unique flavors that make it everyone's favorite. Farmer; Miller; Baker. Know your bread from grain to loaf. Great bread starts with great ingredients, which is why at Izzio we collaborated with local farmers and millers to create a custom flour made from wheat that we can trace directly to the farm. 100% traceability ensures our flour is pure, without GMO's, enrichments or additives. We use only authentic small batch baking methods and extended natural fermentation, where some loaves can take up to 72 hours. We choose to ferment our doughs for a long time in order to make bread that is not only more delicious but also better for you. The long fermentation creates great flavor and texture and also helps break down the starches and gluten, making our breads easier to digest. We at Izzio believe that what we do makes eating bread more enjoyable!
Wheat Flour, Sourdough Culture (Wheat Flour, Water), Water, Sea Salt, Enzymes.
Contains: wheat

Take & Bake: 400 degrees F oven; 7-10 minutes; Ready. Baking Instructions: Pre-heat oven to 400 degrees F; Remove thawed bread from bag and place on middle oven rack. Bake for 7-10 minutes or until crust is preferred golden brown color. For frozen bread, bake 10-13 minutes. Remove bread from oven and let cool for a few minutes, then enjoy! If not planning to bake bread day of purchase, then freeze and enjoy later. Every oven is different! These baking instructions are meant as a basic guideline only. Baker Tip: Prior to baking, mist inside of oven with 2-3 spritzes of water; added humidity will gently awaken the bread, making it more lush, voluminous and create a golden crackly crust. Don't have a spritz bottle? No worries, just run your hands under the faucet with cool water and gently pat the bread before placing it in the oven.

sections.bodyString:
Gluten-free & top 9 allergen-free. Everything. Eat Confidently: Our facility and products are gluten-free & top 9 allergen-free (no wheat, dairy, egg, soy, peanuts, tree-nuts, sesame, fish, shellfish). Each batch is carefully hand-crafted and baked in our own facility in Pennsylvania. We routinely test to FDA standards for gluten and the top 9 common allergens. Food plays such an important role in our lives. It's tough when you can no longer eat the foods you once enjoyed. Since 2012, when several members of my family were diagnosed with Celiac disease, I've been on a mission to recreate food for those with allergies and sensitivities. Our bagels recreate a NY-style experience, dense and chewy on the inside with a great crust on the outside, made without the top 9 allergens. These are unlike any other gluten-free bagel out there! Crafted with Greater Love. - Michelle & The Greater Knead team. Women owned. 
 
• Gluten Free
 
• Kosher
 
• Vegan

sections.bodyString:
Food FOR Life.
100% FLOURLESS SPROUTED WHOLE GRAIN.
ENGLISH MUFFINS.
The Original Complete Protein.
CERTIFIED ORGANIC GRAINS.
Our Ezekiel 4:9 Sprouted Grain English Muffins are inspired by the Holy Scripture verse: "Take also unto thee Wheat, and Barley, and Beans, and Lentils, and Millet and Spelt, and put them in one vessel and make bread of it". Ez 4:9.
We discovered when these six grains and legumes are sprouted and combined, an amazing thing happens. A complete protein is created that closely parallels the protein found in milk and eggs. In fact, the protein quality is so high, that it is 84.3% as efficient as the highest recognized source of protein, containing all 9 essential amino acids. There are 18 amino acids present in these unique english muffins " from all vegetable sources " naturally balanced in nature.
The Live Grain Difference!
Different from most english muffins today, these unique muffins are made from freshly sprouted Live grains and contain absolutely no flour. We believe in sprouting the grains we use in our english muffins because sprouting is the best way to release all of the vital nutrients stored in whole grains*.
To unlock this dormant food energy, maximize nutrition and flavor, we add just the right amount of water to healthy whole organically grown grains which are already bursting with nutrients. Beneficial enzymes are activated which cause the grains to sprout and become a living food. Our exclusive sprouting process not only significantly increases vitamins but also causes a natural change that allows the protein and carbohydrates to be assimilated by the body more efficiently. And even better still, our exclusive baking process preserves these valuable nutrients and retains the important natural fiber and bran.
You can see, taste, and smell THE LIVE GRAIN DIFFERENCE! of Food For Life english muffins. As nutritious as they are delicious. Food For Life sprouted grain english muffins are the substance of a meal " not just something that holds a sandwich together. See the difference fresh sprouts really make. Your body and taste buds will know the difference! With just one bite, you'll know they are a food for life!
* Source: Price-Pottenger Nutrition Foundation
Certified Organic by Quality Assurance International.
Please visit us online for healthy recipes and great serving suggestions.
6 Fork-Split Muffins.
"Take also unto thee Wheat and Barley and Beans and Lentils and Millet and Spelt and put them in one vessel and make bread of it. " Ezekiel 4:9.
QUESTIONS: Are Food For Life sprouted whole grain english muffins gluten-free?
ANSWER: While sprouting promotes the digestibility of grains through enzymatic activity, this product contains naturally occurring gluten found in wholegrains, such as wheat. For Gluten-Free bread products, please visit our website at www.foodforlife.com.

sections.bodyString: 100% whole grain. 16% fiber. All natural. We still bake our crispbread following the original family recipe used when the bakery was first founded in the 1920's. We have retained its simplicity and original, natural ingredients - Swedish whole grain rye flour, fresh water from our own spring, yeast and a pinch of salt. Nothing more, nothing less. Our crispbread is made from 100% whole grain rye flour, using the rye grain and the husk in the baking process. The husk, the outer layer, is packed with healthy fiber, and the crispbread contains 16% fiber, vitamins and minerals. The classic Swedish way to enjoy crispbread is to spread it with butter and top with a thin slice of cheese. But cream cheese with a little piece of ham and a slice of tomato taste just as good, or then there's egg, salami, avocado - Or why not try them all and decide which one you like best? One last thing, our rye has earned the Swedish quality assurance symbol - Svenskt Sigill. This label guarantees that the rye is produced on a Swedish farm that complies with stringent food safety and environmental responsibility standards. www.leksands.se. Product of Sweden.

Our crackers, as with all of our Sourdough products, are made with Boudin's authentic, San Francisco Mother Dough that is rolled out and cut into artisan cracker shapes. sections.bodyString: Southern pecans and whole wheat with a touch of wildflower honey. Meet Effie - Boston 1959. Back in Nova Scotia, Joan's mother, Effie MacLellan, learned a generations-old recipe for oatcakes that she carried to her new home in Boston. On baking days, Effie would send her children out with stacks of warm biscuits, wrapped and ready to share with the neighborhood. Joan and her longtime friend, Irene, knew these biscuits were exceptional and wanted to pass Effie's tradition to the next generation. sections.bodyString: Est. Brooklyn 2008. Why French Ice Cream? Eggs. Plenty of 'em. Turns out, when you use twice as many egg yolks as standard ice cream you have to call it French Ice Cream. Because a life without anything good is bad. Ever since 2008, when Van Leeuwen was born out of a yellow truck on the streets of NYC, we've been making good ice cream from good ingredients that makes you feel good. sections.bodyString:
Fire toasted
Fire-toasted sugar with sea salt, vanilla, and grass-grazed milk. A perfect balance of salty and sweet.

As a teen, Jeni loved learning from the French pastry apprentices at La Chatelaine, the Columbus bakery where she worked. One chef regaled her with stories of the “salty” caramel from his hometown in Brittany. What the chef meant to say was salted caramel. But, lost in translation, Jeni interpreted his version as extra-salty, like Scandinavian licorice—saltier than standard salted caramel. So when she began making ice cream a few years later, in 1996, Jeni made a burnt sugar ice cream with vanilla and a heavypinch of sea salt. What she imagined this salty French caramel tastes like. It was an instant hit. Now considered Jeni’s signature, we still make it the same way we always have—by caramelizing sugar in a kettle over fire. It’s a dangerous method that requires a lot of precision, but it’s worth it. This is why our caramel has such a beautiful, nutty quality. Adding cream and grass-grazed milk enhances the butteriness of the caramel.

Our fresh-frozen wild blueberries are perfect in cereal, smoothies, muffins, salads, desserts and more! Washed & ready to serve. 
 
• Wild blueberries are naturally smaller than cultivated blueberries, meaning more berries per bite and a more intense blueberry flavor
 
• Wild blueberry bushes were planted by mother nature thousands of years ago and only grow commercially in a tiny corner of the world (Maine and eastern Canada)
 
• Wild blueberries have up to 2x the antioxidant activity as ordinary/cultivated blueberries and antioxidants help keep our bodies healthy by fighting free radicals
 
• Frozen is fresher: freezing the berries within 24 hours of harvesting allows us to push mother nature’s pause button at the peak of ripeness to lock in both nutrition and taste

sections.bodyString:
Sometimes the simplest foods are the most enjoyable. It doesn’t get much less complex than Campofrio Jamón Serrano. We take only the finest cuts of pork and the perfect amount of salt, letting it dry-cure to perfection. The result is a deep, rosy hue with a sweet, white fat, a slightly chewy texture, and sweet, earthy aromas. Our Jamón Serrano is a palate pleaser on its own, but probably most famously enjoyed with fresh cantaloupe or Manchego cheese. Make an easy tapa with tortillas, fresh tomato and garlic salsa, and patatas bravas. Wrap slices around fresh bread or vegetables like asparagus for easy and delicious appetizers. Just because you might not be able to make it to Spain right now, doesn’t mean you shouldn’t eat like the Spaniards do. At Campofrio, we are committed to quality, know-how, and a passion for detail. For this
reason, we are a leading brand in Spain for meats that includes traditional chorizo and Jamón Serrano. We only use authentic recipes that have been carefully handed down through generations to allow you to “Enjoy Espana” wherever you are through the world of tapas.

Since 1868. Martinelli's gold medal. From U.S. grown fresh apples. No additives of any kind. Drink your apple a day. Established in 1868, S. Martinelli & Company is a fifth generation family business in California's beautiful Pajaro Valley near Monterey Bay, where the cool coastal climate and fertile soils produce some of the world's most flavorful apples. More than 50 gold medals for product excellence have been awarded to Martinelli's Gold Medal apple juice products. Martinelli's Gold Medal apple juice is made from a special blend of the finest varieties of U.S. grown fresh apples. In Martinelli's unique process, fresh apples are blended to achieve a perfect balance of natural sweetness and tartness, then washed, sorted, cold-pressed, filtered and flash pasteurized to retain the natural fresh apple flavor. Basic Cooking Instructions: Stovetop: Bring 2 quarts water to a boil in a pot with 1 tsp salt. Add 1 cup rinsed farro, return to a boil, then reduce the heat to medium-high and boil uncovered until soft, about 30 minutes. Drain off cooking water, then serve. Pre-Soak Method: Cover 1 cup farro with water and soak in the refrigerator overnight, then drain. Place in a pot and add 3 cups water or stock (enough to cover the grains). Bring to a boil; reduce heat to medium-low and simmer for 10 minutes. Drain excess liquid and serve. Slow Cooker: Place 1 cup rinsed farro, 4 cups water and 1 tsp salt into a slow cooker. Cover and cook on low for 2-2½ hours or high for 1½ hours. Drain excess water and serve. Multi-Cooker: Place 1 cup rinsed farro, 3 cups water and 1 tsp salt in the pot of a multi-cooker. Set the valve to sealing. On manual setting and high pressure, set for 12 minutes. Quick release the pressure. Drain excess water and serve. Makes 4 servings (about 2 cups). sections.bodyString: Rissotto with porcini mushrooms and italian arborio rice. Italy is Europe's largest producer of rice. The wetlands and cool temperatures of the Lombardi region harbor the ideal conditions for lush rice fields. Resourceful Italians combined rice with many other items common to their area and developed a dish they lay claim to. It is known as risotto. Rich, creamy risotto is one of Northern Italy's gastronomic delights. The key ingredient in authentic risotto is the short, thick grained rice known as Arborio. This rice is the perfect grain for risotto because its texture and cooking properties allow it to retain firmness throughout preparation. Risotto should always be prepared al dente which means tenderyet firm to the bite. Alessi Risotto Con Funghi Porcini offers a most unique blend of flavor. Funghi Porcini are a particular type of mushroom found throughout woodlands beneath pine trees. They are known for their woodsy, aromatic scent and are a wonderful addition to this Italian favorite. This skits a wonderful accompaniment to most grilled meats, especially lamb. www.alessifoods.com. Try our other authentic risottos and buon appetito!

sections.bodyString: Milanese style with saffron and Italian arborio rice. Italy is Europe's largest producer of rice. The wetlands and cool temperatures of the Lombardi region harbor the ideal conditions for lush rice fields. Resourceful Italians combined rice with many other items common a dish they lay claim to. It is to their area and developed known as risotto. Rich, creamy risotto is one of Northern Italy's gastronomic delights. The key ingredient in authentic risotto is the shore thick grained rice known as Arborio. This rice is the perfect grain risotto because its texture and cooking properties allow it to retain firmness throughout preparation. Risotto should always be prepared al dente which means tender yet firm lone bite. Alessi Risotto ago Milanese is the classic risotto dish of Arborio rice is coupled with saffron, the world's not expensive spice. This robust, intensely flavored dish is the most highly regarded of all risottos and is may served with meats cooked M a red or wine sauce like Osso Buco. www.alessifoods.com. sections.bodyString:
Try our bold, daring, delicious noodles.  At Snapdragon, we make delicious food inspired by the streets and kitchens of Asia. We are famous for noodles but everything we make is jam-packed with flavor. We’re constantly looking for interesting and exciting ways to celebrate the collision of global cuisines with an Asian bent. For us, big, loud, smack-you-in-the-tastebuds-flavor is way more important than tradition for tradition’s sake. In fact, we love traditional dishes and recipes…as long as they’re absolutely delicious.
Call us irreverent. Call us brash. We’re cool with whatever you want to call us as long as it’s in the name of scrumptious food that scratches the craving itch. We’re noodle masters, not brain surgeons. We aren’t saving lives unless someone’s life depends on a soul-satisfying bowl of pho or cup of ramen in their hands and ready to eat in a matter of minutes. In that case, sure, we’ll wear the hero’s cape to save the day.
We think food should be fun. So throw away those precious formalities, grab some chopsticks, a spoon, fork, spork, whatever, and get your slurp on. Try Snapdragon Ramen. Try Snapdragon Pho. 
 
• BOLD, DARING, DELICIOUS CHICKEN PHO:  Delivers a soothing punch with bright spices and rich umami flavors that get soaked up by rice noodles that are ready to be slurped
 
• WHAT IS PHO?  Pho is a Vietnamese slow-simmered soup prepared with broth, rice noodles, protein, and toppings
 
• SLURP UP:  Each pack contains rice noodles, seasoning blend, flavoring oil in packet
 
• MOST LOVED INSTANT PHO: Snapdragon Instant Pho is packed with flavor, inspired by the streets and kitchens of Asia
 
• CONVENIENT:  3 min to eat - Microwave or just add boiling water

Rice Noodles: Rice, Tapioca Starch, Sugar, Salt, and Cellulose Gum. Soup Base: Salt, Sugar, Yeast Extract, Onion* and Spices*, Disodium Guanylate and Disodium Inosinate, Silicon Dioxide, Caramel Color and Citric Acid. Flavoring Oil: Soybean Oil, Spices and Garlic Extract, Artificial Chicken Flavor (Sunflower Oil, Triglyceride, Flavorings), Spices* and Turmeric, and Oleoresin Paprika. Vegetable Pack: Carrot*, Spring Onion*, and Onion*. *dried

sections.bodyString: Drained Weight: 29 g (1.05 oz). No preservatives or additives. Easy open. The anchovy is integral to Basque cuisine and is a mainstay of the region's fishing economy. The Spanish name Boqueron comes from the size of the anchovy's mouth or boca, which is large in proportion to the rest of the body. Anchovies are typically harvested in the spring when they accumulate the most fat and flavor. Small harvest nets are used to protect the quality of the fish and to reduce by-catch. Once caught the anchovies are gutted, washed and then placed in barrels in layers separated by salt for 3-7 months. Weights are used to encourage salt penetration and to deepen the flavor and aroma of the fish. The product is then washed to remove bones, skin and salt, and it is then packed in oil. The final product is a source of Omega-3 and is also rich in unsaturated fatty acids. This product has been produced free of soy, gluten, nuts, dairy, and genetically engineered ingredients. www.matizespana.com. www.cullinarycollective.com.

sections.bodyString: Eden Hacho Miso is the product of generations of experience and perfected techniques. The U.S. organic soybeans are cleaned, soaked, cooked, and crushed, then shaped into two-inch crosses, creating the maximum surface area for the growth of koji. The bean crosses are then lightly dusted with a mixture of Aspergillus oryzae spores and roasted barley flour, then incubated for 48 to 72 hours, depending on the season. When incubation is complete, the crosses are covered with a fragrant bloom of pale yellow koji growth. The koji covered crosses are mixed with a small amount of water and sea salt and transferred to huge cedar vats. These 200-year-old vats are approximately seven feet deep and seven feet in diameter. Each vat holds several tons. Large pieces of thick cotton cloth and heavy wooden discs or pressing lids are placed on top of the inoculated soybean mixture. A pyramid of large river stones, usually 100 or more and equal to the weight of the soybean mixture, is built on top of the pressing lid. The enzymes from the koji slowly mellows the mixture, transforming the complex protein, carbohydrates and fats of the soybeans into dark, rich, flavorful miso as it ages/ferments for up to three full summers. It is then double bagged in a resealable, standing pouch. No chemicals or additives of any kind are used whatsoever.
Organic Whole Soybeans, Water, Sea Salt, Organic Roasted Barley Flour, Koji (Aspergillus oryzae)

Miso Soup: 2-3 inch pieces Eden Wakame leaf or 1 tsp Eden Wakame Flakes; 4 cups water; 1 small onion, thinly sliced; 1 carrot, diced; 1 1/2 to 2 tbsp Eden Hacho Miso dissolved in 2 Tbsp water or soup broth; 2 green onions, finely sliced. Optional ingredients: tofu, dried tofu, shiitake, greens, daikon, lotus root, turnip, leeks, and noodles Rinse wakame, soak in cold water to cover 5 minutes and dice, or add flakes directly, no soaking required. Bring water to a boil Add onions and wakame. Simmer 3 minutes. Add carrots and simmer 5 minutes. Reduce flame to very low. Add miso and simmer 2 minutes. Do not boil. Garnish with green onions. Serves Refrigerate after opening.

sections.bodyString:
McCann's Imported Original Quick & Easy Steel Cut Irish Oatmeal helps you start your day off right with a delicious and easy-to-make hot cereal meal that is ready in 5 minutes. A perfect breakfast food, a versatile baking ingredient and great for overnight oats, this steel cut oatmeal delivers the truly distinct flavor and rich texture of unprocessed, 100% whole grain oats. Each canister of McCann's kosher, non-GMO oatmeal comes with 17 servings packed with fiber and 4 grams of protein per serving. Enjoy all the natural goodness of  oatmeal by adding 1/4 cup of steel cut oats to a 3/4 cup of boiling water and let it simmer on low heat for 5 to 7 minutes. You can also just add water and microwave steel cut oats in a deep microwave-safe bowl for 3 minutes. Stir well and cook for an additional 2 to 3 minutes. Allow it to stand for 1 minute before serving original oatmeal and add your favorite toppings for a hearty flavored oatmeal bowl. 
 
• One 24 oz canister of McCann's Imported Original Quick & Easy Steel Cut Irish Oatmeal
 
• Non-GMO oatmeal that delivers the truly distinct flavor and rich texture of unprocessed, 100% whole grain oats

• Certified kosher, non-GMO original oatmeal cup that you can enjoy as a snack at home or as a quick breakfast on the go

100% Whole Grain Irish Oats

Cooking Directions: Range Top (per serving): Recommended cook method. Bring 3/4 cup of water to a boil. Add 1/4 cup McCann's Quick & Easy Steel Cut Oatmeal. Reduce heat to low, simmer uncovered for 5-7 minutes, stirring regularly. Remove from heat and allow to stand for 2-3 minutes before serving. Microwave (per serving): Combine 3/4 cup of water with 1/4 cup of McCann's Quick & Easy Steel Cut Oatmeal in a 2 qt microwave-safe bowl (the size of the bowl is important as it must be large enough to allow the oats to bubble without spilling over). Microwave on high for 3 minutes. Stir and then cook for an additional 2-3 minutes. Remove from microwave and allow to stand for 2-3 minutes before serving. Note: As microwaves are different, cooking times may vary. For thicker oatmeal, use less water.

Harry Gray. Did you know. We use little more than sun, wind, water and fire to power our mill? Producing Ireland's favorite oatmeal in small batches with tradition and pride. A Family’s Passion For Oats: Since 1785, our Flahavan's family mill has been nestled beneath the Comeragh Mountains in County Waterford, amid a trove of natural resources and small-scale farmers who are dedicated to growing the finest 100% whole grain Irish oats. Spotlight on Harry Gray: John Flahavan partners with oat farmer Harry Gray. Harry's family has been growing oats for Flahavan's since 1911-his grandfather's time -and this proud tradition now continues with Harry and his sons, Don and Gordon. A bountiful harvest, a kinship with nature and real Irish heritage, from their fields to your spoon. A wholesome and heartwarming oatmeal, naturally rich in texture and made even richer by passion - with a toasted aroma and deliciously creamy taste that is naturally Irish and distinctively Flahavan's. Flatbread in a flash. Makes 8 flatbreads. Soft and flavorful, this irresistible flatbread can be prepared in just about an hour, providing the perfect quick foundation for savory sandwiches and restaurant-quality turnovers. You’ll Need: Dough: 5 Tablespoons (62g) olive oil, divided. 1 Yeast packet, included. 1-1/4 cups (284g) water, hot (115 degrees F to 120 degrees F). Topping: 3 Tablespoons olive oil (37g) or butter, melted (43g). 1 Za'atar herb blend packet, included. Directions: 1. Spread 2 tablespoons (25g) oil on a rimmed baking pan. 2. Stir together flatbread mix, yeast, hot water, and remaining 3 tablespoons (37g) oil in a large bowl until combined. Oil hands then fold sticky dough over onto itself in the bowl for 1 to 2 minutes until smooth; dough will remain tacky. 3. Scoop dough onto the oiled pan. Divide into 8 pieces (about 95g each), shape into balls, and turn to coat in oil. Let rise for 30 minutes, uncovered. 4. Preheat a heavy, dry skillet or grill pan over medium (350 degrees F to 375 degrees F). Pat one piece of dough at a time into a 6 to 7 Inch circle on the baking sheet. 5. Cook for 1% to 2 minutes on each side, stack and wrap in a clean dish towel, and repeat with remaining dough. To add the topping, brush flatbreads with oil or melted butter and sprinkle with Zaatar herb blend before serving warm. Mix it up with pea & feta flatbread pockets. Instructions: There are three ways you can make our cookies: using a stand mixer, using a hand mixer, or using a bowl and spatula... whatever is easiest for you! 1. Vegan Bacon Bits: 2 tbsp soy sauce. 2 tbsp molasses. 2 tbsp liquid smoke. 1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil. 1 tbsp cider vinegar. 3 cups bob's red mill coconut flakes. Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Line a rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper or a silicon pad, or spray with nonstick spray. Whisk together soy sauce, molasses, liquid smoke, olive oil and vinegar. 00 Flour Pizza Dough: 1 tsp Cento Fine Sicilian Sea Salt. 1/2 tsp sugar. 2-1/2 cups room temperature water. 1 kg Anna 00 flour. 1 package (7 g) instant dry yeast. Cento extra virgin olive oil for drizzling. In a large measuring cup, combine salt, sugar and water. In a large mixing bowl, add flour and form a well in the center. Slowly pour water mixture into well, then add yeast. Using a fork, begin beating the water until yeast dissolves. Slowly incorporate the flour until dough begins to form. Place the dough onto a flat, floured surface and knead until it is smooth and elastic; about 5-7 minutes. Drizzle a small amount of oil on the bottom of the bowl to prevent from sticking; place dough into bowl. Cover with plastic wrap and allow to rise completely (approximately 15 minutes). Cut into 3-16 oz. dough balls. Place into separate containers and allow to sit for an additional 30 minutes. Note: If you have any dough balls that are not being used right away, wrap them in plastic wrap, place in freezer bag and store in freezer. Authentic Neapolitan Pizza Preheat oven to 400 degrees F If you are making pizza on a stone, place it into oven while preheating. How To Bake With It: After the first rise, dough can be stored up to 48 hours (covered) in your refrigerator so you can bake at your convenience; simply let it come to room temperature, then shape and bake! For the crispiest crust, top your pizza with cheese once the edges of the crust begin to brown (about two-thirds of the way through baking). Each bag makes approximately ten 12 inches pizzas. Our recipe for Neapolitan-Style Pizza Crust: 2 cups (232g) king Arthur 00 pizza flour. 1/8 teaspoon active dry yeast or instant yeast. 1/2 teaspoon sugar. 1-1/4 teaspoons salt. 3/4 cup (170g) lukewarm water (105 degrees F to 115 degrees F). Stir the ingredients together to make a cohesive, rough dough. Cover end allow the dough to rim at room temperature overnight, or at least 12 hours and up to 24 hours. Divide the dough in half, shape each half into a ball, and place each into a lightly greased bowl. Cover and let rise for 45 minutes to an hour while your oven preheats. Place a baking stone on a rack in the center of the oven; preheat the oven to 500 degrees F. Transfer one dough ball to a well-floured work surface, sprinkle the top with flour and use your fingertips to gently depress the interior of the round (leaving a thicker edge). Stretch the dough into a 10 inches to 12 inches circle. Move the dough to a piece of parchment, trimming any excess parchment around the edge. Spoon sauce on the dough, sprinkle with cheese, then add your toppings. Transfer the pizza on its parchment to the hot stone using a peel or overturned baking sheet. Bake the pizza until bubbly and charred on the edges, 8 to 12 minutes. Remove from the oven and top with grated parmesan, if desired. Repeat with the remaining dough and toppings. Yield: two 12 pizzas.

Pizza crust. Yields 2. 12 in crusts. 3-1/4 cups. Arrowhead mills unbleached bread flour. 1-1/4 cups. Warm water (105 to 115 degrees F). 2-1/4 tsp. Instant dry yeast. 1 tsp salt. 1 tbsp sugar. 1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil. 1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees F. 2. Stir yeast into warm water in small bowl. Combine flour, salt and sugar in large bowl. Stir in Yeast mixture until blended. Add olive oil. Stir 3 minutes or until a smooth dough forms. 3. Coat large bowl with non-stick cooking spray. Place dough in bowl, turning to coat surface. Cover loosely with plastic wrap. Let rise in warm place until doubled in size, about 1 hour. 4 punch dough down. Divide into two equal pieces. Cover with towel. Let rest 10 minutes. 5. Press into two 12-inch pizza pans. Cover and let rise in warm place about 20 minutes. Top crusts with favorite pizza toppings and cheese. 6 bake 25 to 30 minutes or until lightly browned. Parmesan garlic roll. Yields 12-15 rolls. Bread ingredients. 3-3-1/2 cups. Arrowhead mills unbleached bread flour. 1-1/3 cups. Milk (warm to 100 degrees F). 2-1/4 tsp instant dry yeast. 1 tbsp granulated sugar. 3 tbsp olive oil. 1 tsp kosher salt. Garlic spread ingredients. 1/2 cup butter, softened. 1 tbsp minced garlic. 2 tbsp grated parmesan. 1/2 tsp garlic salt. 1 tsp dried parsley. 1/4 tsp ground black pepper. 1/4 cup shredded mozzarella. Dough and Garlic Spread. 1. Add warm milk, yeast, and sugar to the mixing bowl of a stand mixer. Allow yeast to dissolve, about 1 minute. Add 3 cups flour, olive oil, and salt. 2 mix using dough hook attachment until a soft dough forms, about 2 minute. The dough should be sticky, but if too sticky add the additional 1/2 cup of flour by tablespoon full until dough forms a soft ball. 3 cover the dough and allow to sit in a warm place until doubled in size, about 45 minutes. 4 while dough is proofing, prepare garlic spread. Combine all ingredients with the softened butter and mix until creamy. Making the Rolls. 4. Pre-heat oven to 400 degrees F. Lightly spray a 13x9 inch rectangular baking pan with non-stick cooking spray. 5. Once dough has doubled in size, remove from bowl and place on a lightly floured surface. Roll the dough into a 14x10 inch rectangle. Spread the garlic butter spread evenly over the surface. If you have additional parmesan or mozzarella you can sprinkle this over the top. 5. Roll up the dough and cut into 1-1/2 inch slices using a serrated knife. If the dough is too soft to cut, place in the freezer for 10 minutes to chill. 6. Place sliced dough rolls in the prepared pan. Cover and allow to rise 20 minutes prior to baking. Bake at 400 degrees F for 20-25 minutes. Store in a cool dry place.
